decisions.subject: Support topology before hardware
decisions.exact_evidence_or_decision: Designer must choose and substantiate point/area center bearing, retained pivot and sidebearer law; gapped, preloaded and frictional systems cannot share unexamined mount heights/rates.

decisions.subject: Center-bearing and retained pivot
decisions.exact_evidence_or_decision: Resolve compression support and any actual uplift/retention duty separately. A negative center diagnostic does not rate a pivot bolt or permit operation on it.

decisions.subject: Actual spring stations
decisions.exact_evidence_or_decision: Obtain real upper/lower seat locations and guide/axlebox motion, including brake-reaction pitch. Two separated coils aggregate only with proven equal displacements; no actual8coil coordinates are closed.

decisions.subject: Whole-coach and guide coupling
decisions.exact_evidence_or_decision: Body/other-truck roll/torsion, massCG, sidebearer preload/friction/contact/wear, yaw resistance and guide/brake reactions need the coordinated actual geometry/dynamics, not this imposed-body boundary.

decisions.subject: Physical fabrication release
decisions.exact_evidence_or_decision: Actual contact plate areas/materials, spring/sidebearer curves, frame/crossmember/bolster/pivot joints, fits/bolts/welds/inspection require controlled interfaces and responsible engineering before dimensions are released.
